en.text: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 「我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，好叫你们存活，人数增多，且进去得耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许的那地。

zhTraditional.text: 「我今日所吩咐的一切誡命，你們要謹守遵行，好叫你們存活，人數增多，且進去得耶和華向你們列祖起誓應許的那地。

en.text: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

zhSimplified.text: 你也要记念耶和华—你的 神在旷野引导你这四十年，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守他的诫命不肯。

zhTraditional.text: 你也要記念耶和華－你的上帝在曠野引導你這四十年，是要苦煉你，試驗你，要知道你心內如何，肯守他的誡命不肯。

en.text: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。

zhTraditional.text: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活着不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裏所出的一切話。

en.text: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

zhSimplified.text: 这四十年，你的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿。

zhTraditional.text: 這四十年，你的衣服沒有穿破，你的腳也沒有腫。

en.text: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

zhSimplified.text: 你当心里思想，耶和华—你 神管教你，好像人管教儿子一样。

zhTraditional.text: 你當心裏思想，耶和華－你上帝管教你，好像人管教兒子一樣。

en.text: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

zhSimplified.text: 你要谨守耶和华—你 神的诫命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。

zhTraditional.text: 你要謹守耶和華－你上帝的誡命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。

en.text: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华—你 神领你进入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，从山谷中流出水来。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華－你上帝領你進入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，從山谷中流出水來。

en.text: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

zhSimplified.text: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树，和蜜。

zhTraditional.text: 那地有小麥、大麥、葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹，和蜜。

en.text: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

zhSimplified.text: 你在那地不缺食物，一无所缺。那地的石头是铁，山内可以挖铜。

zhTraditional.text: 你在那地不缺食物，一無所缺。那地的石頭是鐵，山內可以挖銅。

en.text: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.

zhSimplified.text: 你吃得饱足，就要称颂耶和华—你的 神，因他将那美地赐给你了。」

zhTraditional.text: 你吃得飽足，就要稱頌耶和華－你的上帝，因他將那美地賜給你了。」

en.text: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

zhSimplified.text: 「你要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华—你的 神，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；

zhTraditional.text: 「你要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華－你的上帝，不守他的誡命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；

en.text: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕你吃得饱足，建造美好的房屋居住，

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕你吃得飽足，建造美好的房屋居住，

en.text: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

zhSimplified.text: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，并你所有的全都加增，

zhTraditional.text: 你的牛羊加多，你的金銀增添，並你所有的全都加增，

en.text: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

zhSimplified.text: 你就心高气傲，忘记耶和华—你的 神，就是将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来的，

zhTraditional.text: 你就心高氣傲，忘記耶和華－你的上帝，就是將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來的，

en.text: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

zhSimplified.text: 引你经过那大而可怕的旷野，那里有火蛇、蝎子、干旱无水之地。他曾为你使水从坚硬的磐石中流出来，

zhTraditional.text: 引你經過那大而可怕的曠野，那裏有火蛇、蠍子、乾旱無水之地。他曾為你使水從堅硬的磐石中流出來，

en.text: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

zhSimplified.text: 又在旷野将你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要苦炼你，试验你，叫你终久享福；

zhTraditional.text: 又在曠野將你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，是要苦煉你，試驗你，叫你終久享福；

en.text: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕你心里说：『这货财是我力量、我能力得来的。』

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕你心裏說：『這貨財是我力量、我能力得來的。』

en.text: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

zhSimplified.text: 你要记念耶和华—你的 神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的，为要坚定他向你列祖起誓所立的约，像今日一样。

zhTraditional.text: 你要記念耶和華－你的上帝，因為得貨財的力量是他給你的，為要堅定他向你列祖起誓所立的約，像今日一樣。

en.text: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

zhSimplified.text: 你若忘记耶和华—你的 神，随从别神，事奉敬拜，你们必定灭亡；这是我今日警戒你们的。

zhTraditional.text: 你若忘記耶和華－你的上帝，隨從別神，事奉敬拜，你們必定滅亡；這是我今日警戒你們的。

en.text: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华在你们面前怎样使列国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们不听从耶和华—你们 神的话。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華在你們面前怎樣使列國的民滅亡，你們也必照樣滅亡，因為你們不聽從耶和華－你們上帝的話。」
